text:
PACK BURST CS-pack-web3 — export the playable CLIFFSIDE SCENE (bare foreground + four parallax layers + follow camera) with the FROZEN exporter (Run C-3, Matt R-C3-42/48). task_id "CS-pack-web3".

Run exactly once, substituting OUT = the absolute path of this burst's out/ directory: cd /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst && python3 -B -m export.godot_import --cells /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/cells_v7 --out OUT/godot --parallax /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-parallax-in-v8 --vfx-kits /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/vfx_kits/kits_web2.json --sockets /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/sockets_v2.json --props /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-props-v14
Do NOT pass --scene, --vfx or --gear-variant. Do NOT run Godot (the conductor runs the headless proof outside this sandbox). Paste the command's JSON stdout (or its stderr on failure — do not work around a failure) into out/exporter.json. Then write out/README_scene.txt (≤ 15 lines): how to open it (Godot 4.6 → Import → out/godot/project.godot → Run Project), controls (arrows/WASD move, Shift run, Space jump, E or left click cast, Tab = next VFX set), what is in the scene (painted cliffside foreground, parallax layers sky 0.12 / far_ruins 0.25 / forest_valley 0.45 / mist 0.70, follow camera at 12.5 % figure height, collision from the walkable data, VFX: FROZEN ORB v3 only (our own authored painted-pixel kit built to the hybrid oracle spec: no white flipbook frame, tint ramp, bright halo + floor light + flash layer) — this is the PUBLIC web-playtest export, no third-party library VFX, the whole level dressed with trees, burnt snags, stumps and props, living ember glows with rising embers, canyon embers and ash drift, one near-camera object (the canyon hoodoo), the dead cow moved to the far plateau with a buzzing fly swarm, a raven perched on the north-west bridge post, the burning gothic cathedral in the ruins layer, walk E/W/SW one-stride re-cuts; plus the layered props from --props: trees and a scorched snag that fade when the Keeper walks behind them, stumps, a crate/barrel cache, rocks, include the exporter's near_coverage report line if present) and the VFX credit lines from the project CREDITS_VFX.txt.
No image_gen. No code. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. BUDGET under 10 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-pack-web3"; images []; files: out/exporter.json, out/README_scene.txt, out/godot/project.godot, out/godot/scenes/*.tscn, out/godot/scripts/*.gd with sha256 (PNG copies may be omitted); status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
